confirmed_bugs.title: Runtime secret updates are not saved
confirmed_bugs.expected: GET immediately reflects an updated runtime secret and the secret survives restart.
confirmed_bugs.actual: GET omits the new secret until another state save; restart before that save loses the credential.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Merged: both observations originate from updating the secret registry without triggering a conversation state save.

confirmed_bugs.title: Non-string secret values return 500
confirmed_bugs.expected: Numbers, null and booleans are rejected with 422.
confirmed_bugs.actual: A number in secrets causes an unhandled 500.

confirmed_bugs.title: Switch requests reuse stale registered LLM configuration
confirmed_bugs.expected: A switch installs posted or current profile configuration, or rejects the request.
confirmed_bugs.actual: A 200 success silently retains an older LLM when its usage_id was registered earlier; editing a saved profile is ignored on later switch.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Merged: both variants use the first-write-wins LLM registry and silently reuse the previous registration.

confirmed_bugs.title: Switching before first run loses usage accounting
confirmed_bugs.expected: The successful switched model call appears under its usage_id in stats.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The run finishes but switched usage has no token or cost entry.

confirmed_bugs.title: Acknowledged mid-run switch remains absent from persisted state
confirmed_bugs.expected: GET and persisted state reflect the acknowledged LLM switch.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Socket switches immediately while GET and base_state retain default until the tool step exits; crash in that interval can lose the acknowledged switch.

confirmed_bugs.title: Pre-run ACP model switch accepts whitespace
confirmed_bugs.expected: Blank model ids are rejected and the prior model remains.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Whitespace is accepted with 200 before the ACP session exists.

confirmed_bugs.title: Native model switch endpoints alter ACP placeholder LLM
confirmed_bugs.expected: switch_llm and switch_profile reject ACP conversations and retain acp-managed config.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The endpoints accept and replace the ACP agent placeholder LLM.

confirmed_bugs.title: Unsupported ACP model id returns 500
confirmed_bugs.expected: A model id absent from available_models is rejected with a client error.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The Claude ACP adapter model switch surfaces an internal 500.

confirmed_bugs.title: TypeScript ACP switch docs promise an absent 409
confirmed_bugs.expected: Docs explain that a pre-run switch is stored and returns 200.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Both switchAcpModel docstrings promise 409 before first message.

confirmed_bugs.title: Loading a plugin twice duplicates hook side effects
confirmed_bugs.expected: Repeated plugin loading keeps one copy of its hooks.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Skills stay deduplicated but identical user_prompt_submit hooks are appended twice.

confirmed_bugs.title: Fork tags differ between state and stored metadata
confirmed_bugs.expected: GET and meta.json agree on inherited tags.
confirmed_bugs.actual: GET drops source qa=src while meta.json retains it.

confirmed_bugs.title: Fork drops model credentials and cannot continue
confirmed_bugs.expected: The fork retains encrypted agent and condenser keys and can run with source history.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Fork base_state has no API key; continuing a DeepSeek fork fails authentication.
confirmed_bugs.notes: Merged: failed continuation follows from the same missing cipher when fork state is saved.

confirmed_bugs.title: Final-response endpoint returns abandoned branch answer
confirmed_bugs.expected: Navigating HEAD before the answer makes the active-branch final response empty.
confirmed_bugs.actual: agent_final_response still returns the abandoned answer.

confirmed_bugs.title: Disabled condenser is reported as an internal server error
confirmed_bugs.expected: Missing or no-op condenser is a client configuration error.
confirmed_bugs.actual: A disabled/no-op condenser triggers an unhandled 500 with traceback.

confirmed_bugs.title: Side question on unknown conversation returns 500
confirmed_bugs.expected: Unknown conversation is documented 404.
confirmed_bugs.actual: ask_agent returns internal 500.

confirmed_bugs.title: Goal resume runs beyond max_iterations
confirmed_bugs.expected: No goal status reports iteration above max_iterations.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Resuming after failed last judge reports capped 2 of 1 and performs another round.

confirmed_bugs.title: Restart leaves an inactive goal marked running forever
confirmed_bugs.expected: A loop cancelled by restart is reported interrupted and inactive.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Conversation restores paused but its latest goal status remains active/running.

confirmed_bugs.title: Sandbox pause leaves open conversation sockets silent
confirmed_bugs.expected: Existing sockets close or continue delivering rehydrated conversation events.
confirmed_bugs.actual: An open socket remains bound to the unloaded service and receives no later new events.

confirmed_bugs.title: Pending file-credential binding poisons a native conversation
confirmed_bugs.expected: A cold native conversation never acquires an ACP credential-binding requirement.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Binding while native conversation is unloaded creates a persistent requirement that blocks later loading after pause.

confirmed_bugs.title: Model switch loses managed API key refresh hook
confirmed_bugs.expected: An in-scope switched LLM retries a 401 after fetching managed key.
confirmed_bugs.actual: First run refreshes; after switch the 401 surfaces, no second fetch or retry, conversation errors.

confirmed_bugs.title: Bash timestamp filters compare local spelling rather than instant
confirmed_bugs.expected: Equivalent UTC and non-UTC offset timestamps select the same events.
confirmed_bugs.actual: UTC selects the command while equivalent +02:00 timestamp selects none.

confirmed_bugs.title: Bash output paging filters order after page limit
confirmed_bugs.expected: limit=1 with order__gt=0 returns the next output chunk.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The result is empty with a next_page_id; SDK pollers can miss later chunks and time out.

confirmed_bugs.title: Synchronous bash execution truncates output above 1 MiB
confirmed_bugs.expected: execute_bash_command returns all 1100012 stdout characters.
confirmed_bugs.actual: It returns only the final chunk, losing the first 1048576 characters.

confirmed_bugs.title: Malformed scoped bash conversation id produces 500
confirmed_bugs.expected: A non-UUID conversation id is rejected with 422.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The dependency reads unset runtime_event_service and produces 500.

confirmed_bugs.title: Idle eviction kills a running scoped bash command
confirmed_bugs.expected: Running scoped commands keep their conversation loaded and can be stopped normally.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Eviction kills the active sleep process and writes no final BashOutput, leaving pollers without termination.

confirmed_bugs.title: Invalid upload target is reported as server failure
confirmed_bugs.expected: Directory target or parent-file collision yields 4xx.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Upload maps both collisions to a masked 500.

confirmed_bugs.title: Remote upload results omit file_size in Python and TypeScript
confirmed_bugs.expected: Both remote clients report the 70000-byte upload size, as LocalWorkspace does.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Bytes upload intact; Python returns None and TypeScript returns undefined for file_size.

confirmed_bugs.title: Failed overwrite destroys the previous file
confirmed_bugs.expected: Mid-write EFBIG failure leaves the previous uploaded file intact.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The existing target is truncated and replaced by 500000 partial bytes despite 500.

confirmed_bugs.title: Case-only sibling directory names loop pagination
confirmed_bugs.expected: Pagination over Foo and foo reaches both directories.
confirmed_bugs.actual: The lowercased cursor repeats the first page indefinitely.

confirmed_bugs.title: Archive format description omits nested-repository selection
confirmed_bugs.expected: The OpenAPI format description matches archive contents.
confirmed_bugs.actual: It promises the entire directory but a single nested repository excludes adjacent top.txt.

confirmed_bugs.title: Concurrent trajectory exports share and corrupt one temporary ZIP
confirmed_bugs.expected: All concurrent downloads return 200 and valid ZIP bytes.
confirmed_bugs.actual: Shared temporary path is overwritten/unlinked across handlers, causing broken downloads and 500s.

confirmed_bugs.title: Trajectory export ignores init-time conversations_path
confirmed_bugs.expected: Both trajectory routes export the conversation stored at the initialized path.
confirmed_bugs.actual: GET finds the conversation but trajectory export reads the launch-time default and returns 404.

harness_map_issues.title: Cold OpenAPI doctor probe times out under CPU contention
harness_map_issues.actual: F08.secrets-restart, F10.restart-persist and F14 upload-atomic/restart stop at the required OpenAPI read while health/auth/SHA/socket checks pass.
harness_map_issues.adaptation: Isolated map copies retry doctor once; original timeout evidence is preserved.
harness_map_issues.notes: Original doctor probes use http_client(10); no product code changed.

harness_map_issues.title: Mid-run recipes start before socket subscription
harness_map_issues.actual: Primary capture contains the sleep observation but misses its earlier ActionEvent.
harness_map_issues.adaptation: Create with --no-run, wait for socket full_state, then POST /run; same real DeepSeek prompt and assertions.

harness_map_issues.title: Selected restart recipes omit state-arranging dependencies
harness_map_issues.adaptation: Added F10.fork-independent/navigate-empty and F14.upload-download/scoped-transfer in isolated copies.

harness_map_issues.title: Docker recipe remains unconditionally blocked on a capable host
harness_map_issues.adaptation: Removed blocked label only in isolated copy, selected frozen-source image, added own-container safe inspection and missing lifecycle assertions.

harness_map_issues.title: Docker error-path recipe assumes no daemon without arranging it
harness_map_issues.adaptation: Explicit missing DOCKER_HOST Unix socket ensures intended no-daemon path.

harness_map_issues.title: Harness does not automatically redact newly issued container session credentials
harness_map_issues.actual: Redactor recognizes run keys and selected env values, rather than the session_api_key response field.
harness_map_issues.adaptation: Capture raw output directly, reveal only boolean presence proof, register key via recognized OPENHANDS_API_KEY env before recording exchanges.
harness_map_issues.notes: Awaiting two fresh Docker runtime observations; never include credential value in screen/report/evidence.

harness_map_issues.title: Docker build filled 32GB overlay and aborted evidence writes
harness_map_issues.actual: ENOSPC left primary F12.json/F14.json empty, with 27/29 feature ledger rows intact.
harness_map_issues.recovery: Root removed only owned disposable Docker build caches; 26GB free; affected tails replayed separately.

blocked.title: Running Codex ACP credential write-back
blocked.prerequisite: Codex ACP binary plus OpenAI login not provided
blocked.route: External credential source PUT with expected_version/value
blocked.notes: F12 activation, scrubbing, binding scope and reload guard are driven; provider-driven credential refresh synchronization is not reached.

inconclusive.title: Initial error-path socket keepalive timeout under contention
inconclusive.actual: Capture logged sent 1011 keepalive ping timeout; no interrupted goal frame was received.
inconclusive.notes: Fresh low-concurrency repeat pending before classifying product vs environment.
